lines.trans: What kind of person was he, Arkadiy?
He could have become a very good boss.
If not for his greed?
If only he had never taken bribes.
And if he had not betrayed his friends.
And had not envied another's wealth.
In every person there are different sides.
In everyone there is bad.
But after all there is good too!
Yes, good is always there too.
The main thing is to remember this in time.
Power changes people very strongly.
But you were able to remain human.
Thank you, Marina, that is very important to me.

meanings.note: large amount of money or property

examples.text: Я потерял абсолютно всё своё богатство.
examples.trans: I lost absolutely all my wealth.

examples.text: Главное богатство страны — это её люди.
examples.trans: The main wealth of the country is its people.

meanings.note: 'брать' alone often means this, in talk about officials

examples.trans: We have to take all the money.

meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: adds a reason or an obvious truth

examples.trans: I did tell you, you know!

meanings.note: идти во власть = go into government

examples.trans: People need to go into government themselves.

вовремя.gloss: on time, at the right moment

meanings.en: on time, at the right moment

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.
We could open a salon for you.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

завидовать.gloss: to envy, to be jealous of

examples.trans: I envy you in a good way.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!
'менять что на что' = to swap something for something

examples.trans: I'll swap an iPhone for a phone.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: ничего не осталось = there's nothing left

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

предавать.gloss: to betray, to be unfaithful to

examples.text: А ты сейчас свою семью предаёшь!
examples.trans: And you are betraying your family right now!

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.trans: The wind is blowing hard outside.

meanings.en: to be able to, to manage to

examples.trans: We came as soon as we could.
Will you be able to come tomorrow morning?

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.

meanings.note: neuter чужое as a noun = other people's things

examples.text: Вы так и берёте чужое без спроса?
examples.trans: So you just take other people's things without asking?

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
